name: @pipeworx/mcp-urlhaus

tools.name: lookup_url
tools.description: Look up a URL in the URLhaus malware database to check if it is known to host or distribute malware. Returns threat category, status, blacklist status, and tags.

url.description: The full URL to look up (e.g. "http://example.com/malware.exe").

tools.name: lookup_host
tools.description: Look up a hostname or IP address in the URLhaus database to find associated malware URLs. Returns all known malicious URLs hosted on that host.

host.description: Hostname or IP address to look up (e.g. "example.com" or "192.168.1.1").

tools.name: get_recent
tools.description: Get a list of recently submitted malware URLs from URLhaus. Useful for monitoring the latest threats.

limit.description: Number of recent URLs to return (default 10, max 1000).

tools.name: lookup_payload
tools.description: Look up a malware payload file by its MD5 or SHA256 hash in the URLhaus database. Returns file type, size, first/last seen dates, and associated delivery URLs.

md5_hash.description: MD5 hash of the payload to look up (32 hex characters).

sha256_hash.description: SHA256 hash of the payload to look up (64 hex characters).

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-urlhaus forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the urlhaus pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
